text.description_html:
Omnia 368 Solid Brass Lever Only, Pair

Functionality is what this lever is all about. Lever is constructed of tough, non-rusting solid brass.

Specifications for Omnia 368 Modern Door Lever

  • Lever Length: 4-1/2"
  • Lever Projection: 2-1/2"
  • For commercial and residential use
  • Solid Brass Construction
  • Oil rubbed Bronze finish

This is the lever only. Does not include the rosettes, etc.

*Sold in Pairs
